name: Western blot — sample run
description: Single-day Western blot. Synthetic Phase-2 fixture; mirrors a Benchling Notebook Entry with the Protocol template applied.

blocks.content: ## Equipment needed: SDS-PAGE rig, transfer cell, blocking shaker.

blocks.name: Cell lysis
blocks.description: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer for 30 minutes on ice.

blocks.name: Load SDS-PAGE
blocks.description: Load 20 µg per lane and run for 60 minutes at 120 V.

blocks.content: Carefully remove the gel; rinse in transfer buffer.

blocks.name: Transfer to membrane
blocks.description: Transfer at 100 V for 90 minutes at 4°C.

blocks.name: Block membrane
blocks.description: Block in 5% milk-TBST for 60 minutes on the orbital shaker.

blocks.name: Primary antibody
blocks.description: Incubate with primary antibody overnight at 4°C with gentle shaking.
